scores.evidence: The cycle-flow diagram (pages/mobile-jp-16.png, mobile-jp-17.png) is a readable top-down flowchart with Japanese labels and a caption. The step lists, prompts and code blocks render cleanly. On mobile, dr-table (pages/mobile-jp-03.png) is wider than 390 px and its second column is clipped until you scroll sideways. Line 16 of ex-settings is clipped on both mobile and desktop (pages/mobile-jp-09.png, desktop-jp-06.png).

textOnlyScreens is empty on both desktop and mobile. Every section mixes headings, steps, prompts, a figure or a check, and none of the 30 mobile screens is a wall of text. On desktop the measured median is 42 chars per line against a 30–40 target. That comes from the reader's 680 px measure, not the lesson.

All screens are Japanese with lang=ja. Glossary terms are underlined, and key presses render as keycaps (Shift+Tab, Ctrl+G in c-plan, pages/mobile-jp-18.png). Contrast is good throughout. There are no awkward breaks inside Japanese words, and no control is hidden under the top or bottom bars.

niceToHave: dr-table: at 390 px the second column ('足す部品（学んだ回）') runs past the screen edge and is clipped until you scroll sideways (pages/mobile-jp-03.png, mobile-jp-04.png). Shorten the column 2 cells (for example 'スキル（第7回）' without the English gloss) and the header (for example '足す部品'), or turn the table into a list so it fits without scrolling.

ex-settings: line 16, the long hook "command" string, is clipped at the right edge on desktop and mobile (pages/desktop-jp-06.png, pages/mobile-jp-09.png). The command is spelled out in ex-hook, so nothing is lost, but a shorter command or a comment pointing to step ③ would avoid the cut.
reader: wide tables and code blocks have no scroll cue (known behaviour).
reader: the end banner says this is the course's last lesson because drafts are not in course.json (known behaviour).
reader: on desktop the median is 42 chars per line against a 30–40 target, set by the 680 px measure.
summary: metrics.json has no hard failures: no horizontal overflow, console errors, mermaid errors, unknown blocks or broken images. No screen is text-only, and no personal data shows on any screen I opened. The lesson reads well on both mobile and desktop, with a clear flowchart, well-chunked steps and copyable prompts. The only visual weak spots are dr-table and line 16 of ex-settings, which need sideways scrolling at 390 px; shortening them would remove that.
